verses.pali: “Yato kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno paññāya cittaṁ suparicitaṁ hoti, tassetaṁ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno kallaṁ vacanāya:
verses.english: “Mendicants, when a mendicant’s mind has been well consolidated with wisdom it’s appropriate for them to say:

verses.pali: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṁ brahmacariyaṁ, kataṁ karaṇīyaṁ, nāparaṁ itthattāyāti pajānāmī’ti.
verses.english: ‘I understand: “Rebirth is ended, the spiritual journey has been completed, what had to be done has been done, there is nothing further for this place.”’

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno paññāya cittaṁ suparicitaṁ hoti?
verses.english: And how is a mendicant’s mind well consolidated with wisdom?

verses.pali: ‘Vītarāgaṁ me cittan’ti paññāya cittaṁ suparicitaṁ hoti;
verses.english: The mind is well consolidated with wisdom when they know: ‘My mind is without greed.’

verses.pali: ‘vītadosaṁ me cittan’ti paññāya cittaṁ suparicitaṁ hoti;
‘vītamohaṁ me cittan’ti paññāya cittaṁ suparicitaṁ hoti;
‘asarāgadhammaṁ me cittan’ti paññāya cittaṁ suparicitaṁ hoti;
verses.english: … ‘My mind is not liable to become greedy.’

verses.pali: ‘asadosadhammaṁ me cittan’ti paññāya cittaṁ suparicitaṁ hoti;
verses.english: … ‘My mind is not liable to become hateful.’

verses.pali: ‘asamohadhammaṁ me cittan’ti paññāya cittaṁ suparicitaṁ hoti;
verses.english: … ‘My mind is not liable to become deluded.’

verses.pali: ‘anāvattidhammaṁ me cittaṁ kāmabhavāyā’ti paññāya cittaṁ suparicitaṁ hoti;
verses.english: … ‘My mind is not liable to return to rebirth in the sensual realm.’

verses.pali: ‘anāvattidhammaṁ me cittaṁ rūpabhavāyā’ti paññāya cittaṁ suparicitaṁ hoti;
verses.english: … ‘My mind is not liable to return to rebirth in the realm of luminous form.’

verses.pali: ‘anāvattidhammaṁ me cittaṁ arūpabhavāyā’ti paññāya cittaṁ suparicitaṁ hoti.
verses.english: … ‘My mind is not liable to return to rebirth in the formless realm.’

verses.pali: Yato kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno paññāya cittaṁ suparicitaṁ hoti, tassetaṁ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno kallaṁ vacanāya:
verses.english: When a mendicant’s mind has been well consolidated with wisdom it’s appropriate for them to say:

verses.pali: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṁ brahmacariyaṁ, kataṁ karaṇīyaṁ, nāparaṁ itthattāyāti pajānāmī’”ti.
verses.english: ‘I understand: “Rebirth is ended, the spiritual journey has been completed, what had to be done has been done, there is nothing further for this place.”’”
